work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: The act names Cardinal Fransoni apostolic visitor of the Reformed Franciscan convent and college of San Pietro in Montorio. Issuer evidence GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF7920; own dating clause LF7956–7959 reads: Daturh Romae apud sanctam Mariam Maio- rem sub annulo piscatoris die trigesima augusti millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo primo, pon- tificatus Nostri anno primo.. Own provenance note LF7910 excluded as edition furniture. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
